name: Pimple Saudagar
summary: A residential neighbourhood in Pimpri-Chinchwad, east of Wakad and near Aundh, close to the Pavana and Mula rivers.
knownFor: Housing societies with active resident associations
Located near the Pavana and Mula rivers
connectivity: PCMC bridge across the Pavana links it to Pimprigaon
Road access to Wakad to the west and Aundh to the south-east
suits: Families wanting a residential Pimpri-Chinchwad neighbourhood within reach of Wakad, Hinjewadi and Aundh.
